title: Looking for Help Downloading Databento NQ 1-Minute Data
author: becoolwan
selftext:
Hi everyone, I’m looking for someone who can help me download the CME E-mini Nasdaq-100 (NQ) OHLCV-1m historical data from Databento. They currently offer $125 in free credits, but a valid credit card is required to sign up, which I don’t have.  
If you already have a Databento account with free credits, or if you’re able to download the full historical OHLCV-1m dataset and share it with me, I would really appreciate your help.  
Thank you very much!  
Email: salihberwan@gmail.com

replies.author: Spiritual_Exam_8528
replies.body: Na L0 1min bars are super hard to come by. I bet databento, alpaca, finnhub, polygon, not even yfinance have a better way to get this.

replies.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
replies.body: Inside of databento you can get your API key tell the ai that you want to safely integrate databento api key  and then follow the instructions and save your databento API key then you can have it pull the information you want in the chat.

comments.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
comments.body: Why don’t you just tell the AI to get it for you? I’m confused.

replies.author: becoolwan
replies.body: My issue isn’t using the API. I don’t have a valid credit card to create a Databento account and claim the free credits. If anyone already has a Databento account with available credits and could download the NQ 1-minute OHLCV historical data for free

replies.author: Ok_Doughnut_189
replies.body: Understood if that’s the case look for a free source hard to use databento without a creditcard look into GitHub’s with market data integrations and reliable high quality free market data sources
